Fiscal-health panel around each merger

Source: R/panels.R
merger_fiscal_panel.Rd

Stacks the donor's years up to its merger year and the recipient's years before and after its merger year, with harmonized measures from merger_measures() and, optionally, fiscal-health ratios and a composite index from the 'fiscal' package.

Usage

merger_fiscal_panel(
  cases,
  oy,
  pre = 5L,
  post = 5L,
  ratios = TRUE,
  fit = NULL,
  weights = NULL,
  smooth = c("none", "trailing"),
  k = 3L
)

Arguments

cases

Output of build_merger_cases().

oy

Organization-year table from org_years().

pre, post

Years before and after the merger year. Donors are kept only through their merger year.

ratios

Compute 'fiscal' ratios (requires the 'fiscal' package).

fit, weights

Optional fitted 'fiscal' model and weights; adds fh_* dimension scores and the fiscal_health index.

smooth

"none" or "trailing".

k

Trailing window length in years.

Value

A data.table, one row per merger, role, and year, with MERGER_ID, MERGER_GROUP_ID, ROLE, EIN2, TAX_YEAR, TIME_FROM_MERGER, measure columns, and (if requested) ratio and index columns.

Comparability over time

Ratios come from fiscal::compute_all_panel(). Its winsorized, standardized, and percentile variants are re-estimated within each tax year, so they rank organizations within a year rather than measure change. To track change, pass a fit (a fitted fiscal::fiscal_health_fit() model calibrated once on a reference sample) and weights (fiscal::fiscal_weights()). Every organization-year is then scored with the same fixed parameters.

Smoothing

smooth = "trailing" replaces the financial fields with trailing k-year averages (smooth_trailing()) before measures and ratios are computed. Use smoothed values for matching and baselines. Use raw values (smooth = "none") for event-time outcome estimates, because a trailing window spreads a real post-merger change over k years.
